scope_boundaries: REG-VCE-ROBUST-001 is explicitly blocked and is not counted as implemented support.
Weighted, heteroskedasticity-robust, clustered, and other non-classical covariance estimators were not audited.
Rank-deficient and other degenerate designs are outside the frozen supported cases.
Complete-case fitting changes the analysis sample and does not justify a missing-at-random claim.
The audited estimator has no causal interpretation without a separate identification design.
decision_reasons: All 17 normalized release-critical metrics have role-appropriate support and complete formula-to-code-to-test mappings.
Public 95% confidence intervals and constant/no-constant Total-row df/MS are separately mapped and tested.
Primary mathematical sources, original-method evidence, and authoritative compatibility documentation were accessible and their roles remain separated.
No theoretical contradiction or formula-to-code mismatch was found.
This theory audit does not issue the final validation gate decision.
